enrichment.headline: Awards Pinguelo Construction $3.05M to replace windows at Havenscourt and Lockwood campuses
enrichment.summary: The district is hiring Pinguelo Construction, Inc. of Fairfield to remove old windows and install new dual-pane windows at three buildings on the Havenscourt Middle School and Lockwood STEAM Academy campuses. The lump sum of $3,045,000 includes $60,000 in contingency allowances, and Pinguelo was the lowest responsive, responsible bidder. Work is expected to run from January 26, 2023 to January 25, 2024.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Eliminates vacant staff positions from the 2022-23 district budget
enrichment.summary: The Board is asked to adopt a resolution eliminating vacant full-time-equivalent positions from the 2022-2023 adopted district budget. The text lists two different numbers of positions, 27.9 and 25.9, so the exact count is unclear from the official wording.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.sourceIssue: The action text gives two different FTE figures, 27.9 and 25.9, for the vacant positions being eliminated, so the number of positions cut is unclear.
items.title: Position Control: Position Changes Requiring Board Approval

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $98,000 for North Bay Soccer Referee Association to officiate school soccer games
enrichment.summary: The district is approving, after the fact, a contract with the North Bay Soccer Referee Association of Sonoma to provide officials for all scheduled middle and high school soccer games and to continue a certification program for officials. Cost is capped at $98,000. The agreement started December 1, 2022, before this approval; the official text gives an end date of June 30, 2022, which appears to be a misprint.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.sourceIssue: The text gives the agreement period as December 1, 2022 through June 30, 2022, so the end date falls before the start date, leaving the term unclear.
items.title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 - North Bay Soccer Referee Association - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $6,000 for English classes for parents at Elmhurst United Middle School
enrichment.summary: The district is approving, after the fact, a contract with an Oakland instructor to teach English to parents who are not native speakers. The lessons focus on everyday language for talking with school staff and supporting their children's success. The cost is capped at $6,000 for September 5 to December 16, 2022, paid from Title I funds.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 - Emma Donnelly - Elmhurst United Middle School

enrichment.headline: Ratifies $5,001 for Space80seven to produce a music-industry career event at Fremont High
enrichment.summary: The district is approving, after the fact, a contract with Space80seven LLC of Stockton to produce a career-exploration event called "The Business of Music Presents" for interns in grades 10 to 12 at Fremont High School. It includes one 60-minute assembly per grade level with live performances and a magazine roll-out. The cost is capped at $5,001 for December 1, 2022 to January 31, 2023.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 - Space80seven LLC - Fremont High School

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $41,000 for Space80seven music-industry internship at Fremont High School
enrichment.summary: The district is approving, after the fact, a contract with Space80seven LLC of Stockton for a work-based learning internship for nine students in Fremont High's Media Academy and Architectural career programs. Students get hands-on training in the music industry, mentorship from professionals and career field trips, including a two-day trip to Los Angeles. The cost is capped at $41,000 for December 1, 2022 to May 31, 2023.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 - space80seven LLC - Fremont High School

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $7,500 for a contractor to write school-based health program reports
enrichment.summary: The district is approving, after the fact, a contract with a San Francisco consultant to write reports and analyze data for the School Based Health Incentive Program. The work is run through the Community Schools and Student Services Department. The cost is capped at $7,500 for October 10, 2022 to June 30, 2023, funded by Alameda Alliance for Health.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 - Moira De Nike - Community Schools and Student Services Department

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $350,000 for Mountain Valley School to serve students with special-ed plans
enrichment.summary: The district is approving, after the fact, its 2022-2023 master contract with Mountain Valley School of Nevada City, a nonpublic school. The school provides special education services that students' Individualized Education Programs require. The cost is capped at $350,000 for July 1, 2022 to June 30, 2023.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Accepts $90,000 from Eat. Learn. Play. Foundation for library and mindfulness corners at Garfield
enrichment.summary: The district is accepting a $90,000 grant from the Eat. Learn. Play. Foundation on behalf of Garfield Elementary School. The money pays to build out library and mindfulness corners at the school, as described in an annex to the grant letter. The grant period is November 9, 2022 to June 30, 2023.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Applies to continue state funding for the district's child care program in 2023-24
enrichment.summary: The Board is asked to approve the district's application to the California Department of Education to continue funding for its General Child Care and Development Program for fiscal year 2023-24. The resolution also authorizes staff to sign the contract documents. No dollar amount is stated.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Accepts $7.67M more from the state for preschool, raising the grant to $26.39M
enrichment.summary: The district is accepting an increase to its California State Preschool Program grant, raising it from $18,714,123 to $26,386,261 for July 1, 2022 to June 30, 2023. The required number of child days of enrollment rises from 235,724 to 332,363, and the minimum days of operation stay at 240. All other contract terms stay the same.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: The district is approving, after the fact, a contract with Living Jazz of Oakland to teach music to students in transitional kindergarten through 5th grade. Students learn about instruments, songs in different languages and basic notes, which supports language, literacy, math and movement. The cost is capped at $5,000 for December 1, 2022 to May 24, 2023.
